title: Sectionwise formula for set-valued underived exchange
statement: Let $\square$ be a Cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square, def-pc-scheme] with arrows $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to Y'$, and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Define $\operatorname{Ex}^{0,\mathrm{set}}_{\square,F}:g^{-1}f_*F\to f'_*g'^{-1}F$ as the transpose under $f'^{-1}\dashv f'_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image] of $g'^{-1}\varepsilon_f\circ\theta_\square$, where $\theta_\square:f'^{-1}g^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}g'^{-1}f^{-1}$ is the canonical inverse-image comparison [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. For an etale object $V\to Y'$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], a presheaf representative (an element of the presheaf inverse image whose sheafification is the set-valued inverse image of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]) of a section of $g^{-1}f_*F$ is $(W\to Y,\ a:V\to Y'\times_YW\text{ over }Y',\ s\in F(X\times_YW))$. Put $A=X'\times_{Y'}V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] and let $\ell_a:A\to X'\times_X(X\times_YW)$ be induced by the square and $a$. The image of the sheafified class [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $(W,a,s)$ under $\operatorname{Ex}^{0,\mathrm{set}}_{\square,F}$ is the restriction of $s$ along $\ell_a$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], after applying the inverse-image unit $F\to g'_*g'^{-1}F$; equivalently it is $\ell_a^*(\eta_{g',F}(X\times_YW)(s))\in(g'^{-1}F)(A)=(f'_*g'^{-1}F)(V)$. The rule is independent of representatives and natural in $F$.
